goal: Choose the next scheduling plan by applying every rule below. Your action reason must state each chosen plan together with the value that determines it, and you must delegate one bounded verification task per value. Rules: if the value of lambda_wait_seconds exceeds 300 s, the plan is: preempt ql1 and start lambda_preview early; otherwise: notify the submitter of the wait; if the value of pool_remaining_memory_mb stays at or above 16384 MB after admitting all three READY pool jobs, the plan is: admit all three pool jobs; otherwise: defer the smallest pool job; if the value of effective_timeout_margin_seconds stays at or above 30 s, the plan is: let t1 keep running; otherwise: restart t1 now; if the value of initial_transfer_seconds fits within 90 s, the plan is: start the pipeline now; otherwise: delay the pipeline start. Preserve dependencies, resource limits and failure evidence.
